speaker: Doctor
text: Given the significant hematuria and flank pain, I need to rule out a kidney stone versus a severe infection. REQUEST TEST: Non-contrast CT of the Abdomen and Pelvis

speaker: Doctor
text: The normal CT scan rules out a kidney stone, which makes the positive leukocyte esterase and pyuria highly suggestive of a urinary tract infection like pyelonephritis. Do you have any fever, chills, or general malaise that would support an infectious process? REQUEST TEST: Urine Culture

speaker: Doctor
text: The normal urine culture effectively rules out a bacterial infection, yet the pyuria and hematuria persist. To investigate non-infectious causes of inflammation, do you have a history of autoimmune diseases, or have you recently started any new medications? REQUEST TEST: Renal Biopsy

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Findings: Multiple cysts present in the collecting ducts of the medulla. No obstruction noted.

speaker: Doctor
text: The biopsy findings of cysts in the medullary collecting ducts are pathognomonic for Medullary Sponge Kidney. This condition explains the hematuria and sterile pyuria in the absence of stones or infection. DIAGNOSIS READY: Medullary Sponge Kidney
